Notes_and_Tips: Seafood is a great protein choice: keep it mainly at lunch for best energy.
Social gatherings: eat your planned meal first, then choose one small item only.
Keep dinner light and earlier to avoid next-day bloating and cravings.
Bedtime (optional): warm turmeric milk (small cup, no sugar) or warm water.
SIMS / nutrition theory note: protein-first meals and steady timing improve satiety and stable energy.
Keep cooking simple: pressure-cooked curries and pan-fried fish with minimal oil.
